change: Ordinary and mini timelapse source streaming without an on-disk reconstructed sequence.

tests.targeted: hybrid_timelapse_stream_test.py and hybrid_source_rendering_test.py passed on isolated Raspberry checkout; final stderr diagnostic change is included in the full run

proof: Decoded video pixels match the equivalent display sequence for standard/wrap, deflicker off/on and mixed archives.
Wrap comparisons use the frozen d6ebc510 implementation.
Ordering follows exposure date and initial skip is retained.
Actual FITS replay with an evicted cache encodes the same decoded video as its display pixels; FITS bytes are unchanged.
Stream preprocessing creates no sequence files.
Missing middle frames and failed encoder terminate/reap child and remove partial output; large stderr cannot block frame delivery.
limits: Exact codec comparisons use PNG display fixtures; JPEG-derived streams preserve decoded preview pixels without another lossy intermediate encoding.
Not deployed; panorama generation, retention, portable recipe publication, day/night settings and external storage remain open.
